descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
ANSWER THE DISTRESS CALL
  
  Remote outposts have gone silent. Alien creatures have overrun the outer colonies and the surviving colonists are running out of time. You are their last option.

  Deploy solo or squad up with up to 3 friends. Navigate infested planetary bases, locate survivors, and fight your way to extraction.

  FEATURES
  - Solo or co-op multiplayer for 1-4 players
  - Extraction missions through alien-infested bases
  - Physical VR weapon handling — grab, reload, fire
  - Voice chat for real-time squad coordination 
  - Multiple difficulty levels — easy to overwhelming
  - Room-scale VR, optimized for Quest 2 & Quest 3

  THE INFESTATION SPREADS
  Each mission takes you deeper into infected facilities where alien creatures hunt in the shadows. Every corridor could be your last.

  Actively developed — new content releasing regularly.

  CAN YOU SECURE THE BASES?
  Every mission is a fight for survival. Every shadow could be hiding danger.
